overview.text: Lissette Rivera is a small business owner and former Public Works Committee member. In January 2026, her appointment to the city's Recreation and Community Services Commission was on the City Council's agenda. She is co-founder and president of WOLF (War On Lethal Fentanyl). Her campaign priorities include supporting police and firefighters, repairing streets and parks, reducing small-business red tape, expanding STEM education, protecting seniors and veterans, and increasing government transparency.
